Name: Jehoshaphat, Priest of the Ark
Summary: Priest who blew with the trumpet before the ark of God.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:24: Priest who blew with the trumpet before the ark of God.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehoshaphat in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
